transcript.text: This is the third time this month my internet has dropped in the middle of a video call. I work from home, this is costing me.
I'm sorry about that. I can see two prior outage reports on this line. Let me run a line diagnostic.
You ran a diagnostic last time too and nothing changed. I need someone to actually fix this or I'm switching providers.
Hi, my prepaid balance shows $0 but I recharged this morning.
Checking now — the recharge posted but wasn't applied to your active plan. I've applied it manually, you should see it now.
Yep, showing now. Thank you, that was fast!
how do i turn on wifi calling
Settings > Network > Wi-Fi Calling > toggle on. Takes about a minute to register.
got it, works now
Our whole office line is down. We have twelve people who can't take customer calls right now.
I understand the urgency. I'm opening a priority ticket and looping in the business network team.
How long is this going to take? We're losing business every minute this is down.
I was charged $45 in roaming fees. Nobody told me international roaming wasn't included.
I see the charge. Since this is your first time traveling on this plan, I can issue a one-time courtesy credit.
Fine, I guess, but this should have been disclosed before I traveled.
I wanted to say thank you, the agent yesterday fixed my SIM issue in like five minutes.
That's great to hear, I'll pass that along to the team.
I bought the 5GB add-on an hour ago and it still isn't active. I'm out of data.
I can see the purchase went through but the activation is stuck in queue. Let me push it manually.
Please hurry, I need this for work.
need to add a fourth line to our business plan
Done — line added, SIM ships in 2 business days, prorated charge will show on next invoice.
great, thanks
I've called three times this week about the same billing error and every time I'm told it's fixed. It's not fixed.
I apologize for the repeated issue. I can see the prior two tickets were closed without the credit being applied.
I want to speak to a supervisor. I'm done explaining this from scratch every time.
Can you tell me when my contract renews?
Your current term ends 2026-11-15, it'll auto-renew month-to-month unless you choose a new plan.
Perfect, thanks.
My data speeds have been really slow the last few days, like unusably slow.
You've used 92% of your monthly high-speed allotment, after that you're on the reduced-speed tier per your plan.
Oh, I didn't realize that was how it worked. Okay, that explains it.
We were promised a dedicated account manager when we signed the enterprise plan six weeks ago. We still don't have one.
I apologize for the delay, let me escalate this to our business accounts team directly.
This is the second time I've had to chase this down myself.
can i check my data usage over text
You've used 6.2GB of 15GB this cycle, resets 2026-08-14.
perfect ty
Following up again on the dropped calls issue from last week. A technician finally came out.
I see the field visit notes — a corroded line connection was replaced. You should notice a real difference now.
It better be fixed after three weeks of this.
I want to port my number from my old carrier.
I can start that now — I'll need your account number and PIN from the old carrier. Port usually completes within 24 hours.
Okay, sending that over now.
Someone has been calling me from spoofed numbers pretending to be your billing department asking for my card info.
That's a scam call, not us — we never ask for full card numbers over the phone. I'll flag this to our fraud team.
Can you actually do something about it though, this has happened four times now.
We need static IPs provisioned for our new office location before Monday.
I've submitted the provisioning request, confirmed turnaround is 3 business days, so it'll land Wednesday, not Monday.
That's tight but workable, please keep me updated.
does my plan include hotspot
Yes, 10GB of hotspot data included, then throttled to 3G speeds.
great thanks
The data add-on from a few days ago finally worked, but I lost almost a full day of data I paid for.
You're right, I can see the delay. I've added a 1GB credit to cover the lost time.
Okay, that's fair. Thanks for sorting it.
I'm seriously considering cancelling. My bill went up $30 with no explanation and this is the second unexplained increase this year.
I can see a promotional rate expired last cycle. Let me pull up retention offers for your account.
I don't want an offer, I want to understand why nobody tells us before these increases hit.
My voicemail isn't set up, can you walk me through it?
Sure — dial *86, follow the prompts to set a PIN and record your greeting. Want to stay on the line while you try it?
Did it, works now, thanks.
Following up on the account manager request — I was told someone would call, nobody did.
I sincerely apologize. I've assigned Priya from our business accounts team directly, she'll call you within the hour.
Alright, I'll give it one more chance.
how do i check my plan expiry date
Your current plan expires 2026-08-20. Recharge before then to avoid service interruption.
ok thanks
Following up on our office outage from last week — wanted to say the fix held, zero downtime since.
Great to hear, I've closed the priority ticket and logged the resolution for reference.
Appreciate the follow-through on this one.
